title: Implement rotary combobox and toggle drawing
description:
Implement Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp (re-write any phase-a stub; this task is sole owner of the .cpp). Include CustomLookAndFeel.h and implement:
1) drawRotarySlider — precision brushed-aluminum knobs on the dark slate chassis using palette Colours (Background/Panel/Border/Text and accent where appropriate).
2) ComboBox drawing consistent with dark slate chassis (panel fill, border, text #F2F2F7).
3) ToggleButton drawing consistent with the same theme.

No audio-thread interaction, no heap in hypothetical audio paths, no locks. Use JUCE 8-compatible Font APIs if the project is on JUCE 8. Do not edit the header except if a compile-breaking signature mismatch forces a follow-up outside this scope — header ownership is f.1; this task writes .cpp only.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h (palette constants and override declarations from f.1)
- Any phase-a CustomLookAndFeel.cpp stub
- JUCE LookAndFeel_V4 method signatures for the overrides declared in the header
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp implements drawRotarySlider as brushed-aluminum precision knobs using the header palette
Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp implements ComboBox and ToggleButton drawing consistent with dark slate chassis colours
cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja && cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone passes
cppcheck --enable=all Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp completes without error exit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add audio-thread work, locks, or heap allocation patterns in processBlock paths
change palette hex values away from header constants

allowed: implement LookAndFeel draw overrides in CustomLookAndFeel.cpp
use JUCE Graphics paths/fills/gradients for brushed-metal rotary knobs
use JUCE 8 Font APIs if required by pinned JUCE version
forbidden: rewrite the header as primary scope
wire editor module accent assignment (editor owns that later)
change build system or plugin formats
